project.name: kloudvestigate
project.purpose: Internal telemetry investigation and publication-material preparation tool for KloudTrack station data.
project.framework: Next.js 16.2.6 App Router with React 19.2.4 and TypeScript.
project.summary: Use this file as the compact project map for future work. The app has server-rendered App Router pages, focused client dashboards, route-handler APIs as the backend-for-frontend layer, server-only KloudTrack access, deterministic telemetry analysis, and demo data fallback when upstream credentials are missing.

client: app/page.tsx renders the main investigation dashboard shell.
app/pubmat/page.tsx renders the publication-material workflow shell.
components/telemetry/* contains client dashboards, forms, tables, charts, and station aggregate workflows.
components/architecture/MermaidDiagram.tsx is the browser-only Mermaid renderer used by the architecture page.
server: App Router pages are Server Components by default unless a child component declares use client.
app/api/investigations/route.ts handles investigation runs and cache lookups.
app/api/pubmat-quick-fetch/route.ts fetches station buckets for publication tables.
app/api/stations/route.ts returns station metadata from KloudTrack or demo data.

majorModules.name: Telemetry UI
majorModules.responsibility: Owns operator controls, quick fetch UX, fetched values tables, summaries, events, and visualization panels.

majorModules.name: KloudTrack API adapter
majorModules.responsibility: Keeps x-kloudtrack-key server-side, resolves metric history endpoints, fetches dashboard/history data, and normalizes upstream responses.

majorModules.name: Telemetry analysis
majorModules.responsibility: Computes deterministic summaries, interval buckets, gaps, duplicates, spikes, flatlines, threshold crossings, range violations, and metric metadata.

majorModules.name: Investigation cache
majorModules.responsibility: Stores recent deterministic investigation payloads in memory for batch lookup and dashboard hydration.

security: assertInternalAccess checks INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in production-like environments.
KloudTrack API keys are read only in server modules and route handlers.
writeAuditEvent currently emits structured audit JSON to console.
Production should run behind SSO or VPN and configure INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
dataFlow: Operator selects station, metric, time range, and interval.
Client component POSTs to an App Router route handler.
Route handler validates internal access and request shape.
Server loads telemetry from KloudTrack or demo data.
Normalizer converts upstream payloads into typed station and telemetry records.
Deterministic analysis creates summaries, anomalies, interval buckets, and record tables.
Client renders tables, charts, events, and status summaries.

diagrams.title: Server Architecture
diagrams.description: Route handlers form a backend-for-frontend layer around authentication, upstream data access, deterministic analysis, caching, and audit logging.

flowchart LR
  Client[Client dashboards] -->|GET/POST| Routes[Next App Router route handlers]
  Routes --> Auth[assertInternalAccess]
  Auth --> Loader[Telemetry loaders]
  Loader --> Demo[Demo telemetry fallback]
  Loader --> Kloud[KloudTrack API adapter]
  Kloud --> Normalize[Normalize station and telemetry records]
  Demo --> Normalize
  Normalize --> Analyze[Deterministic analysis]
  Analyze --> Cache[Investigation cache]
  Analyze --> Response[JSON response]
  Cache --> Response
  Analyze --> Audit[Structured audit log]

diagrams.title: Response Strategy
diagrams.description: The investigation API returns deterministic findings and chart/table data directly to the UI.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Operator
  participant Client
  participant API as Route Handler
  participant Loader as Telemetry Loader
  participant Analysis as Deterministic Analysis
  Operator->>Client: Run investigation
  Client->>API: Send selection
  API->>Loader: Load normalized telemetry
  Loader-->>API: Station and records
  API->>Analysis: Analyze selected metric series
  Analysis-->>API: Summaries, events, intervals
  API-->>Client: JSON investigation payload

environment: KLOUDTRACK_API_TOKEN enables real upstream telemetry; absence uses demo data in current flows.
BETA_KLOUDTRACK_API_TOKEN enables the beta KloudTrack environment.
INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN guards internal API access when configured or in production.
